Python (Jinja2).vuln:
# VULNERABLE: user input is compiled AS A TEMPLATE and executed
from flask import request, render_template_string
name = request.args['name']
return render_template_string('Hello ' + name)   # {{7*7}} -> 49, {{...}} -> RCE
Python (Jinja2).fixed:
# FIXED: user input is DATA passed into a fixed template, never compiled
from flask import request, render_template
name = request.args['name']
return render_template('hello.html', name=name)  # {{ name }} is escaped, not run

Ruby (ERB).vuln:
# VULNERABLE: user input parsed as an ERB template and evaluated
require 'erb'
ERB.new(params[:tpl]).result(binding)   # <%= system('id') %> -> RCE
Ruby (ERB).fixed:
# FIXED: fixed .erb template; user input is a local variable (data)
template = ERB.new(File.read('views/hello.erb'))
name = params[:name]
template.result(binding)   # <%= ERB::Util.html_escape(name) %>
